planets.name: TOI-2019 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2019 with a 15.3-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-2019 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-2019. Its orbit and size follow MacDougall et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
